stretches.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
stretches.description: Move between arching your back up and dipping it low on hands and knees.

stretches.name: Child's Pose
stretches.description: Kneel and lean forward with arms extended.

stretches.name: Downward Dog
stretches.description: Push your hips up and back into an inverted V-shape, pressing your heels down.

stretches.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Lunge
stretches.description: Lunge forward onto one knee, tucking your pelvis to stretch the front of your back leg.

stretches.name: Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Reach for your toes while keeping legs straight.

stretches.name: Side Bend Stretch
stretches.description: Reach one arm overhead and lean your torso deeply to the side.

stretches.name: Shoulder Roll
stretches.description: Roll your shoulders back and down.

stretches.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
stretches.description: Place your forearms on a door frame and lean forward gently.

stretches.name: Quadriceps Stretch
stretches.description: Pull your heel towards your glutes.

stretches.name: Pigeon Pose
stretches.description: Bring one bent leg forward flat on the floor with the other leg extended straight behind you.

stretches.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on your back, lift one leg straight into the air, and pull it gently toward your torso.

stretches.name: Standing Calf Stretch
stretches.description: Step one foot back, press that heel flat into the floor, and lean forward.

stretches.name: Supine Spinal Twist
stretches.description: Lie on your back, drop one bent knee across your body, and look the opposite way.

stretches.name: Knees-to-Chest
stretches.description: Lie on your back and hug both knees tightly into your chest.

stretches.name: Chin Tuck
stretches.description: Draw your head straight back as if making a double chin.

stretches.name: Upper Back Extension
stretches.description: Sit or stand, interlace fingers in front of you, and push your palms away while rounding your back.

stretches.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
stretches.description: Extend your arm straight out, palm down, and gently pull your fingers toward you.

stretches.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
stretches.description: Extend your arm straight out, palm up, and gently pull your fingers downward.

stretches.name: Child's Pose
stretches.description: Kneel and lean forward with arms extended.

stretches.name: Puppy Pose
stretches.description: Keep your hips high over your knees and reach your arms far forward on the floor.

stretches.name: Butterfly Stretch
stretches.description: Sit with feet together and knees out.

stretches.name: Figure-Four Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee, and pull that thigh toward you.

stretches.name: Happy Baby Pose
stretches.description: Lie on your back, grab the outside edges of your feet, and pull your knees down toward the floor.

stretches.name: Cobra Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on stomach and push upper body up.
